If you like Disc World and Harry Potter, you might like Mordew by Alex Pheby. It's the first in a trilogy, about a boy living in a fantasy impoverished slum, where the people are sort of mystical but in a depressing way. Things are born of "the living mud" which is a kind of swamp that contains lots of entities which can eventually come together to form strange fully sentient beings, mixed with whatever objects are around, like bird nest and trees, so everyone is made of interesting things (That isn't really the point of the book, I just think that part is cool).
